revenue.source: Disney FY2025 10-K (acc. 0001744489-25-000155), Consolidated Statements of Income, total revenues

operating_income.source: Derived: total revenues minus total costs and expenses (79,906 / 79,447 / 80,593) per FY2025 10-K income statement; includes restructuring & impairment charges; excludes equity income/interest. Disney does not report a GAAP operating income line

d_and_a.source: FY2025 10-K cash flow statement, Depreciation and amortization

capex.source: FY2025 10-K cash flow statement, Investments in parks, resorts and other property

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.4% (94,425 vs 91,361); modest acceleration from Experiences capacity expansion (cruise, parks) and streaming growth, fading toward GDP-like by FY2030

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 derived margin 14.6% (FY2024 13.0%) was depressed by 819 restructuring/impairment; 16% assumes fewer one-offs and continued segment margin gains

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approx. blended US federal+state and foreign rate; typical Disney effective rate ~20-25%; not verified against FY2025 filing

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 capex 8,024/94,425 = 8.5%, elevated by parks/cruise investment program; held flat as the expansion continues

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~1.2, risk-free ~4.2%, ERP ~5%, cost of equity ~10%, after-tax cost of debt ~4%, ~20% debt weight => ~8.5%

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below risk-free rate

net_debt.source: FY2025 10-K (FYE 2025-09-27): total borrowings 42,026 minus cash and cash equivalents 5,695; no short-term investments identified; lease liabilities excluded

diluted_shares.source: FY2025 10-K, weighted average diluted shares 1,811 million
